name: api_rate_limit_timeout
title: API calls without rate limiting cause secondary rate limit and timeout
symptom: Batches of sequential API calls hang or fail with rate limit errors
cause: Making many rapid requests without throttling triggers the provider's secondary rate limit
fix: Add a small delay between calls, use exponential backoff on 429/503, and batch requests where supported
mal_code:
for item in items:
    api.get(item)  # 65+ rapid calls, no delay
